test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an operating system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Intel is a company that manufactures hardware, particularly processors and other computer components, **not an operating system.**
 
• The other options—Mac (macOS), Windows, and Linux—are all operating systems.
 
• Intel was **founded on July 18, 1968**, by Robert Noyce and Gordon Moore in Santa Clara, California.
 
• Intel's full name is** Integrated Electronics Corporation**, though it is commonly known simply as Intel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Macintosh (Mac) **was developed and launched by Apple Inc. under the leadership of **Steve Jobs in 1976**.
 
• The first Macintosh computer was introduced on January 24, 1984, by Apple Inc.
 
• **Windows 1.0** was released on **November 20, 1985**. It was not a full-fledged operating system but rather an extension of MS-DOS.
 
• **Windows** was developed by Microsoft and the co-founders of Microsoft, **Bill Gates and Paul Allen in 1975.**
 
• **Linux** was created by **Linus Torvalds in 1991** while he was a student at the University of Helsinki in Finland. 
 
• Linux is a free and **open-source operating system**, meaning anyone can view, modify, and distribute its source code.
